parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: The format of the response, one of 'text/markdown' (default), 'text/plain', or 'application/json'.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The name of the model whose dataset allowlist should be used. If omitted, Spice defaults to the only compatible LLM model configured in the Spicepod.

parameters.name: include_sampling
parameters.description: Whether distinct-value samples are included in the context block. Also accepts `sample_data_enabled` for compatibility with `/v1/nsql` request bodies. Default: false.

parameters.name: sampling_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows per distinct-value sample. Default: 3, maximum: 100.

parameters.name: include_examples
parameters.description: Whether example rows are included in the context block. Defaults to `include_sampling` when omitted, matching `/v1/nsql` `sample_data_enabled` behavior.

parameters.name: examples_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of example rows per dataset. Default: 3, maximum: 100.

parameters.name: datasets
parameters.description: Names of datasets to include in the context block. If omitted, all datasets visible to the selected model are included.
